title: Drum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Drum body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- Drum side highlights / zigzag lacing -->
  <path d='M18 56 L30 66 L18 62 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <path d='M82 56 L70 66 L82 62 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <path d='M24 70 L34 58 L40 72 L46 58 L52 72 L58 58 L64 72 L72 58 L78 70' fill='none' stroke='#F1C40F' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Drum top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='34' ry='14' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- Drum top rim edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='34' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#D4A76A' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Inner drum head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Face: smile -->
  <path d='M36 44 Q50 53 64 44' fill='none' stroke='#2C3E50' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- Little sticks -->
  <line x1='58' y1='14' x2='42' y2='36' stroke='#D4A76A' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='16' x2='60' y2='38' stroke='#D4A76A' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='14' r='4' fill='#F1C40F'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='16' r='4' fill='#F1C40F'/>
</svg>
